title: Liria 06 – The Festival of Little Wonders
summary: By the time Liria reached the great marketplace, the sun had already vanished behind the rooftops.
story:
By the time Liria reached the great marketplace, the sun had already vanished behind the rooftops.

Hundreds of lanterns illuminated the streets. Musicians played cheerful tunes, children ran between the stalls, and the scent of freshly prepared food filled the air.

"You there! Would you like to dance?"

An elderly woman beckoned Liria toward a group of dancers.

"I don't know the steps at all!" Liria called back, laughing.

"Then it's high time you learned!"

Before long, Liria was spinning in circles among the townspeople. She stumbled twice, turned the wrong way, and eventually had the entire group laughing.

After the dance, she sat beside a musician playing an unusual stringed instrument.

"I've never heard that song before."

"My daughter wrote it," he explained proudly. "She combined an old melody from our homeland with a new dance rhythm."

Liria listened attentively.

"Then a new tradition is being born right here."

The musician smiled. "Perhaps. If people like it."

Later that evening, Liria heard the same melody in several corners of the marketplace.

Children hummed it. Merchants tapped its rhythm on their counters.

Liria closed her eyes for a moment and enjoyed the music.

She had witnessed the founding of many great cities and important institutions.

Yet sometimes it was a simple song that showed her most clearly how alive Novaris had become.

For a world did not grow through great decisions alone, but also through the joy of its people.
